# NOMAD FIELD — Masahiro Iwamatsu

Official personal archive of Masahiro Iwamatsu / 岩松正浩.

NOMAD FIELD publishes first-party field notes about AI, video production, automation, iOS apps, publishing, music, healthcare, education, travel and coffee. The site is intended to preserve Masahiro Iwamatsu's own experiences, projects and observations as primary-source material.

## Canonical site
https://www.masahiroiwamatsu.com/

## Main sections
- Field Notes: https://www.masahiroiwamatsu.com/notes/
- About: https://www.masahiroiwamatsu.com/about/
- RSS: https://www.masahiroiwamatsu.com/rss.xml
